name: Dragonfly
description: Dragonfly is an in-memory data store compatible with the Redis and Memcached APIs, so existing Redis clients and tools work against it unchanged. It is multi-threaded, uses every core it is given and takes snapshots without forking.

notes.text: Dragonfly refuses to start with less than 256 MiB of free RAM per CPU core. Add RAM when you add cores, or set --maxmemory=<size> in /etc/dragonfly/dragonfly.conf.
When memory is full, writes fail instead of evicting old keys. For cache use, add --cache_mode=true to /etc/dragonfly/dragonfly.conf and run systemctl restart dragonfly.
